title: Delimiter CSV
prompt: Implement `static void SaveScores(string path, List<(int Id, string Name, int Score)> rows)` writing one `id|name|score` line per row, and `static List<(int Id, string Name, int Score)> LoadScores(string path)` parsing them back (missing file → empty list).

tests.name: roundtrip
tests.hint: Save then load must reproduce the data — the round-trip contract.

tests.name: empty
tests.hint: Both empty cases normalize to an empty list.
